original_test_intent: Visually verify the E1S indicator under the BF3/CX8 topology for defined green and amber solid/blink states against an owner-approved LED behavior matrix.
original_method: A qualified on-site operator identifies the exact E1S device and indicator, establishes only approved non-destructive power and I/O states, records timestamped color/cadence evidence, and an engineer dispositions unresolved source states.
manual_activity: An on-site operator maps the BF3/CX8-attached E1S LED, follows an owner-approved state matrix, photographs or videos each defined color/cadence, and records undefined states for engineering disposition.
required_inputs: Exact BF3 or CX8 device, E1S slot, drive/FRU and physical LED location
Owner correction for Green Solid being both on and off when system on
Definition of system state, drive presence and link state for solid green and off
Safe I/O stimulus, expected green blink frequency/duty/observation duration and stop conditions
Reviewed NV CPLD interface/command for Amber Solid, required preconditions and recovery, or explicit exclusion
Definition and stimulus for Amber Blink or approved not-applicable disposition
LED color/cadence legend, viewing conditions, camera evidence standard and acceptance matrix
Independent storage/fabric/BMC recovery and pre/post passive health checks
safety_requirements: Do not resolve the green on/off contradiction by assumption
Do not invent or execute an NV CPLD command and do not claim undefined Amber Blink coverage
Keep hands clear of energized hardware and use only owner-approved I/O or power states
Do not reseat/remove E1S, change cabling, reset BF3/CX8 or alter link state unless separately authorized
Stop on unexpected link loss, drive errors, LED fault, power/thermal anomaly or unsafe visibility
Never treat SSH or telemetry as direct proof of color or blink cadence
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant and isolate the unrelated CPU1 same-code row
Organize the approved BF3/CX8-E1S topology and LED state matrix
Collect passive inventory/link/health context before and after human observation
Ingest timestamped operator photos/video and preserve unresolved-state labels
Perform no visual verdict, CPLD command, I/O generation, hardware manipulation, automatic retry or PASS/FAIL decision
engineer_actions: Correct the green solid/off system-state contradiction
Define the exact LED topology, safe I/O stimulus and measurable cadence
Approve an NV CPLD amber-solid method or exclude it; define/disposition Amber Blink
Review visual and passive health evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL VISUAL REVIEW REQUIRES CORRECTED STATE MATRIX AND APPROVED AMBER DISPOSITION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Label the exact slot and LED in a topology photo, record each owner-defined state on video with a timing reference, and correlate passive link/I/O health without modifying hardware.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns descriptive color labels into an auditable state-to-stimulus-to-cadence matrix while retaining direct human observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The unrelated same-code CPU1/I3C row supplies no LED coverage; the PSB LED in the next row is also a separate physical path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure can make green and amber ambiguous and short video can miss cadence; include a color reference, contextual view and sufficient observation duration.

project_override_considerations: If Amber Solid or Blink is not implemented, the owner must mark it not applicable with the hardware/CPLD revision scope. This must not be converted into an observed PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and both same-code rows with explicit isolation
Approved BF3/CX8-E1S slot/device/LED topology and corrected state matrix
Safe stimulus definitions, green cadence criteria and amber-state dispositions
Timestamped contextual and close photos/video with color reference and observation duration
Passive pre/post E1S health, BF3/CX8 link/I/O state and event evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Within row 1904, Green Solid is stated both On when system on and Off when system on. Amber Solid lacks its required NV CPLD command and Amber Blink is expressly undefined. The distinct row-1831 CPU1 variant sharing the code is separately quarantined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical E1S LED purpose remains identifiable and manually reviewable for owner-defined states; unresolved matrix entries are project inputs and must be reported rather than guessed.

review_improvement: Exposes the green-state contradiction, isolates same-code CPU1 contamination, and requires measurable cadence plus safe amber-state governance instead of a generic visual check.
independent_technical_reasoning: An E1S LED can be driven by device activity, retimer/switch logic or enclosure/CPLD policy, so the same apparent color may not mean the same thing across BF3 and CX8 paths. Direct observation must be bound to the exact slot, topology and stimulus; otherwise a healthy neighboring LED can be photographed while the target path remains untested.
